evidence.why: Static and archive loops use generation stamps differently.

facts.rationale: Corrects the overbroad deduplication claim while preserving the guard, generation and archive duplicate-suppression behavior.
facts.value: The wrapper unconditionally calls `Ground_801C2FE0` and discards its result. The callee does work only when the object's per-map guard is zero, increments a shared collision generation, processes and stamps each matching static joint entry, then processes archive joint entries only when their stamps differ from the current generation. The static loop itself does not test stamps, so a blanket once-per-generation guarantee is not established. A set per-map guard returns false without that processing.
